content_units: Lisbon Family Stay Snapshot
Travel window:   2026-06-10 to 2026-06-14   for   4 nights  .
Best fit based on your priorities:   Hotel D  . Backup pick:   Hotel A  .
Hotel Value Comparison
Hotel   Area   Total 4-Night Cost   Breakfast   Transit Access   Room Size   Family Fit
Hotel A   Chiado     EUR 848     Included   Metro 7 min walk   20 sqm   Great location, but tighter room and near top of budget
Hotel B   Saldanha     EUR 824     Extra cost   Metro 3 min walk   24 sqm   Good size and transit; breakfast surcharge reduces value
Hotel C   Alfama     EUR 780     Included   Tram 4 min walk   18 sqm   Budget-friendly, but small room and stairs are a drawback with a child
Hotel D   Parque das Nacoes     EUR 660     Included   Metro 6 min walk   26 sqm   Best space-to-price value; easiest family comfort trade-off
Best Fit for Your Family
Option 1:   Hotel D — Parque das Nacoes     Best overall match for budget, breakfast, and family comfort     Largest room at lowest total cost
- Total cost stays well under budget at   EUR 660  .
-   Breakfast included   avoids extra daily spend and planning.
-   26 sqm   is the most comfortable room for 2 adults + 1 child in one room.
-   6-minute metro walk   still meets your transit requirement.
- Main trade-off: it is   farther from the historic center  , so sightseeing days may involve longer rides.
View area
Option 2:   Hotel A — Chiado     Best backup if central atmosphere matters more than room size     Best central location
-   EUR 848 total   remains under your   EUR 900   cap.
-   Breakfast included   keeps daily logistics simple.
- Chiado is excellent for walking, dining, and quick access to central Lisbon.
-   7-minute metro walk   is acceptable, though not the closest.
- Trade-off:   20 sqm   is usable but less comfortable than Hotels B or D for a family sharing one room.
Explore Chiado
Option 3:   Hotel B — Saldanha     Sensible middle-ground, but weaker value after breakfast add-on     Strong transit access
- Base room is a good   24 sqm   and metro access is best at   3 minutes  .
- Breakfast adds   EUR 31/day   for your family assuming 2 adults + 1 child.
- 4-night total becomes   EUR 824  , so savings versus Hotel A are modest.
- Better than A for space, but less compelling because breakfast is not included.
Check Saldanha
Option 4:   Hotel C — Alfama     Charming area, but least practical for this family setup     Historic setting
-   EUR 780 total   with breakfast included is solid on price.
-   18 sqm   is the smallest room, which may feel cramped with a child.
- Nearby   stairs   are a real downside for luggage, stroller-like needs, or tired end-of-day walks.
- Tram access is convenient, but overall family convenience is weaker than D or A.
Visit Alfama
Why Hotel D Wins
Your stated priorities in order point to   Hotel D  :
-   One room preferred   → largest room helps most
-   Breakfast included   → yes
-   Walking access to public transit   → yes
-   Total under EUR 900   → comfortably yes

It gives the best combination of   space, included breakfast, transit access, and budget margin  . For a family with a 6-year-old, that extra room space matters more than being in the prettiest central neighborhood.
